_comment: Copy this to mc_sync.json in the project root (next to manage.py) and fill in user + one credential. That file is gitignored: never paste its contents into a chat, a commit, or a bug report.
_auth: Prefer key_path if the host allows it. Use password only if it does not.
_remote: Directory holding kubejs/. Run `python manage.py sync_server --explore` to find it, then set this exactly.
_files: Which files to fetch, relative to remote_root.
_season: Which static/minecraft/<season>/data folder these land in.
_hostkey: Verified host fingerprint. A relative path is read next to this config file.
